transcript.content: Hello, it’s nice to meet you. What brings you in today?

Lately I keep having thoughts that my family would be better off if I weren’t here, and it’s starting to scare me. I've never felt like this before, and it finally made me realize I need to talk to someone.

Have you ever heard or seen things others couldn’t, or strongly believed something others said wasn’t true, especially during this depressed period? Also, have you had any similar depressive episodes in the past, or is this the first time?

No, I’ve never seen or heard things that aren't there, or had any unusual beliefs like that. This is the first time I've ever experienced a depression like this, and these feelings only started after my father had his stroke.

Since your father’s stroke, have your symptoms felt mainly like a reaction to that stress, or have they become severe enough that you’ve lost interest in most things and can’t function in daily life even beyond dealing with his illness?

It started as stress from taking care of my dad, but now it has completely taken over my life. I’ve lost all interest in my hobbies like woodworking and fishing, and I’ve had to cut back my hours at work and hand off projects to my foreman because I can't keep up. At home, I've withdrawn so much that I mostly just sit on the couch and barely interact with my wife and kids.
Have you had thoughts of killing yourself, and if so, have you made any plan or taken any steps to act on those thoughts?

Yes, I have... especially when I'm driving home late from my parents' place, I find myself thinking it would be easier if I just veered off the road or didn't wake up. It really scares me because I've started to picture how I might actually do it and what I'd need to get in order first, though I haven't taken any physical steps to act on it yet.

Have you ever had a period lasting several days when you felt unusually energetic or euphoric, needed much less sleep, talked faster than usual, or did things that were out of character for you? Even if it didn’t happen during this depression, has that ever happened before?

No, I’ve never had a period like that in my life. I’ve always been a very routine-driven person who prefers to keep things steady and organized. This constant heavy, low feeling is the complete opposite of how I usually am.

final_diagnosis.reason: First depressive episode with severe depressive symptoms, marked anhedonia, major functional impairment at work and home, and active suicidal ideation with emerging planning. Psychotic symptoms were denied, and there is no history of manic or hypomanic episodes. Although symptoms began after a major stressor (father’s stroke), the syndrome has progressed beyond a proportional stress reaction into a severe major depressive episode without psychotic symptoms.
